payload.text:
Implemented stdin support for `--check-only` / `--check`.

Change in [main.py](~/muse_agent_study/isort__cc34b2c087/repo/isort/main.py:855): the `file_names == ["-"]` branch previously always called `api.sort_stream()`, ignoring `check`. It now calls `api.check_stream()` with `show_diff` when `check` is set, and sets `wrong_sorted_files` so it exits with code 1 on unsorted stdin, matching file behavior. Sorted stdin produces no stdout and exits 0; unsorted stdin reports `ERROR` to stderr and exits 1; `--check --diff` also prints the unified diff.

Test in [test_main.py](~/muse_agent_study/isort__cc34b2c087/repo/tests/unit/test_main.py:303): added `test_main_stdin_check_only` covering sorted stdin passing, unsorted stdin failing with exit 1 and `ERROR`, and unsorted stdin with `--check --diff` failing while showing the diff.

Verification: new test failed before the fix (`DID NOT RAISE SystemExit`) and passes after. `test_main.py::test_main`, new test, and `test_api.py` pass (7 passed). Full `test_main.py` has 1 failure + 1 error also present on the untouched tree (`ISortCommand` missing and `mocker` fixture unavailable), unrelated to this change.
